info.title: Vendora API
info.description: Vendora personal finance API. Use Bearer token authentication on protected endpoints.

post.summary: Send a message to the support assistant

conversation_id.description: Continue this conversation; omit to start a new one

200.description: Assistant reply and the conversation it belongs to

404.description: Conversation belongs to another user or does not exist

get.summary: List the user's 50 most recent support conversations
Get the messages of one of the user's conversations

404.description: Not found or not owned by the user

delete.summary: Delete one of the user's conversations and its messages

404.description: Not found or not owned by the user

threshold.description: Monthly spending that triggers the alert

put.summary: Change an alert rule's limit or switch it on/off

post.summary: Get a single-use link that signs the current user into the admin panel
Exchange a one-time Google login code for an API token
Create or update a budget entry
Copy last month's budget limits into a month
post.description: Only fills categories that have no budget (or 0) in the target month; never overwrites a limit the user already set.

200.description: Number of budgets copied and the month they came from

get.summary: Get budget summary for a month

post.summary: Create or update a financial record

is_custom.description: Month uses its own base instead of the profile default

base_income.description: Base income when is_custom is true

base_expenses.description: Base expenses when is_custom is true

get.summary: What is left to spend in a month, with the end-of-month projection

200.description: available, days_remaining, pending_income, pending_expenses, daily_avg_spend, projected_balance, daily_allowance

get.summary: Running balance per day for a month and the previous one

200.description: current and previous: one balance per day, null for days with nothing recorded yet

get.summary: Income, expenses and savings of a month against the previous month

200.description: current, previous and change_pct (null with nothing to compare), each with income, expenses, savings

get.summary: Get financial records for a year

200.description: Array of monthly records for the year

is_custom.description: Month uses its own base instead of the profile default

base_income.description: Base income when is_custom is true

base_expenses.description: Base expenses when is_custom is true

get.summary: Get live quote for a symbol
Get candle/sparkline data for a symbol

post.summary: Copy all recurrent transactions to a specific month

get.summary: Monthly report as a PDF: totals, comparison with the previous month, expenses by category and transactions
Get expenses grouped by category for a month

post.summary: Read an ActivoBank statement PDF and preview its movements (nothing is saved)
post.description: Admin only (permission: import statements). Debit/credit is derived from the running balance and the statement's opening/closing balances must reconcile.

200.description: period, reconciliation, rows (date, description, amount, type, is_transfer, is_duplicate, suggested_category_id), file_hash and previous_import ({imported_at, rows_imported} when the same file was imported before, else null)

422.description: Unreadable or unsupported statement; body has a `code`

post.summary: Create the confirmed rows of a statement preview as transactions
post.description: Admin only (permission: import statements). All-or-nothing, 1-500 rows, duplicates are not filtered (the preview flags them).

statement.description: Optional: {hash, from, to} from the preview; stores a light import record

post.summary: Ask the local AI model to suggest a category per statement row
post.description: Admin only (permission: import statements). Only each row's description and type are sent to the model, which runs on local Ollama (never a cloud provider). The answer is advisory and checked against real categories. When no model is available the response is `available: false`, not an error.

200.description: `available`, `busy` (another suggestion of the same user is still running) and `suggestions` (one {category_id, warning} per row, same order)
